items.title: Classify main dirty baseline and doc assets
items.context: Use git status/diff to group tracked modifications, deletions, and untracked docs. Do not touch .omx and do not revert anything before classification.
items.userSees: Terminal report includes: "B-d925 classification: baseline artifacts=<n>, docs=<n>, story metadata=<n>, recommended action=<commit|restore|defer>".

happy.desc: Classification report groups all current main dirty paths into baseline artifacts, docs, story metadata, and untracked docs.

edge.desc: Deleted tracked baseline artifacts are classified separately from modified suite reports and untracked docs.

adversarial.desc: No .omx path is read or used while classifying dirty assets.

verificationEvidence.note: Main dirty classification grouped as 3 untracked docs, 119 tracked deletes, and 23 tracked modifications. Paths were separated into baseline artifacts, docs, and untracked docs for reconciliation.
Tracked deleted baseline artifacts were identified separately: Layer2 has 117 deletes and 4 modifications; Layer3 has 2 deletes and 17 modifications.
No .omx path appeared in the dirty status classification.

items.title: Run two-host audit on the cleanup decision
items.context: Claude CLI and Codex CLI should independently review whether dirty assets should be committed, restored, or deferred. Only real correctness issues may drive changes.
items.userSees: Audit output includes: "Claude=PASS/BLOCK, Codex=PASS/BLOCK, agreed action=<commit|restore|defer>, blockers=<none|list>".

happy.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI both produce independent audit conclusions for the dirty asset groups.

edge.desc: If the hosts disagree, the cleanup does not proceed until the disagreement is explicitly resolved.

adversarial.desc: Host audit does not convert local evidence or host verdicts into Authority Server receipt evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: Claude CLI and Codex CLI read-only audits
verificationEvidence.note: Claude docs auditor and Codex docs auditor both found the main formal-unlock document obsolete/conflicting with B-9d6c. Codex baseline auditor found baseline artifacts BLOCKED/not_authorized and recommended restore/defer rather than commit. Claude baseline auditor also returned BLOCK, though its inventory was incomplete; final auditor did not rely on its optimistic commit suggestion.

verificationEvidence.command: Final auditor reconciliation of four host outputs
verificationEvidence.note: Disagreement was handled by fail-closed logic: stale/BLOCKED baseline artifacts were not committed; only Layer4 document plus synchronized NAV was committed; story-lifecycle and B3787 audit plan were deferred in stash.

All host audit outputs were treated as local non-authority evidence only. No Authority receipt, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or global capability claim was inferred from Claude or Codex host verdicts.

items.title: Apply the minimal reconciliation that unblocks B-9d6c DONE
items.context: Make main clean by committing valid assets or restoring confirmed stale/scratch changes, then verify B-9d6c can advance to DONE.
items.userSees: Terminal output includes: "main clean: yes" and "B-9d6c DONE: success" or an explicit non-dirty blocker.

happy.desc: Main worktree becomes clean after the audited reconciliation and B-9d6c can retry DONE.

edge.desc: If B-9d6c DONE exposes a new explicit blocker, the blocker is reported without further arbitrary cleanup.

adversarial.desc: Cleanup does not use .omx, git reset --hard, or unreviewed deletion of useful Lattice evidence.
